title: Trades
content:
Trades Component
The Trades component contains the following information:
Symbol - The symbol associated with the contract.
Size - The volume of the contract that was traded.
Time - Date and time when the initial trade filled.
Entry Price - The fill price of the contract during the initial trade (opened).
Exit Price - The fill price of the contract when the trade was paired (closed).
P&L - Profit or loss associated with the trade. A Green value indicates a profit. A Red value indicates a loss.
Fees - Round turn exchange and regulatory fees associated with the trade.
To add Trades to your layout, first add it as a component .
Export Trades
To export the data in the Trades component, click the button at the bottom left of the component.
